name: Diameter / Log Shattering (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, $\mathrm D(\mathcal T_n)=n$ while $\mathrm{LS}(\mathcal T_n)=\log(n+1)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $\mathrm{LS}(\mathcal S_n)=\log(n+1)$ while $\mathrm D(\mathcal S_n)=2$.
proof: The recorded value formulae yield a linear-versus-logarithmic gap in one direction and an unbounded logarithmic-versus-constant gap in the other.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Diameter and Log Shattering of Trivial Concepts and Singletons.
